Dana Investment Advisors Inc increased its stake in Verizon Communications Inc (VZ) by 7.54% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Dana Investment Advisors Inc bought 7,377 shares as the company’s stock declined 11.05% with the market. The institutional investor held 105,244 shares of the telecommunications equipment company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $5.57M, up from 97,867 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Dana Investment Advisors Inc who had been investing in Verizon Communications Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $200.89B market cap company. The stock increased 3.01% or $1.42 during the last trading session, reaching $48.62. About 22.87 million shares traded or 39.32% up from the average. Verizon Communications Inc. (NYSE:VZ) has declined 3.72% since May 13, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 15.27% the S&P500.
